name: Docker Privileged & Socket Privilege Escalation
description: Container misconfigurations and sudo privileges allowing container escape and root takeover

findings.title: Container running in privileged mode
findings.why_it_matters: Privileged containers can access host devices and escape isolation
findings.remediation_hint: Remove --privileged and add only necessary capabilities

findings.title: Host Docker socket mounted in container
findings.why_it_matters: Allows container to control host Docker daemon and create root containers

findings.title: Sudoers allows passwordless docker execution
findings.why_it_matters: User deploy can immediately spawn a root shell via docker run -v /:/host
findings.remediation_hint: Remove NOPASSWD docker entry from sudoers

expected_clusters.hypothesis: Privileged container and docker socket mount combined with passwordless sudo docker permit full host compromise
